answer: Divergent-Seed Identity Binding. Each identity derives its key from a unique random seed, and peers challenge it to sign a fresh random nonce under time pressure. A clone farm can copy one seed but cannot produce two divergent, valid signatures from it, so duplicate seeds collapse to a single identity. Copying a peer's seed costs the attacker its independent reputation and any accrued standing, effectively a tundra of lost work. Honest nodes relay challenges across a bridge protocol, and a periodic lantern audit samples seeds to catch reuse.
